definitions.explanation: The process of an area becoming less populated, typically in rural areas due to migration to cities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{農村|のうそん}→農村：04292_nouson⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過疎化|かそか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Depopulation of rural areas is advancing.

examples.japanese: {過疎化|かそか}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{過疎化|かそか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{閉鎖|へいさ}→閉鎖：14524_heisa⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The school was closed due to depopulation.

notes:
{過疎化|かそか} describes the process of an area losing its population, a major social issue in rural Japan as young people move to cities.

FORMS:
⟦{過疎|かそ}→過疎：14756_kaso⟧ (underpopulation) + ⟦{化|か}→化：noentry⟧ (-ization). The ⟦{化|か}→化：noentry⟧ suffix indicates a process of change.

- {過疎化|かそか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: depopulation advances
- {過疎化|かそか}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: countermeasures against depopulation
- {過疎化|かそか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歯止|はど}め→歯止め：09326_hadome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to put a stop to depopulation
